issue.title: [interfaces] mgmt IPv6 address not assigned when IPv6 is disabled on the mgmt port

failure.body:
**Describe the bug**

When `MGMT_INTERFACE` has an IPv6 address, `ifup` writes the `eth0 inet6 static` stanza, but IPv6 can be **disabled on the mgmt port** — `net.ipv6.conf.eth0.disable_ipv6=1`, inherited from the runtime per-interface default. `90-sonic.conf` only clears `net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6`, not `default`/`eth0`. With IPv6 disabled on the port, `ifup` cannot assign the mgmt IPv6 address, so eth0 ends up with **no IPv6 at all** (not even a link-local) even though CONFIG_DB and `/etc/network/interfaces` list one.

**Steps to reproduce the issue**

1. Configure `MGMT_INTERFACE` with an IPv6 address in CONFIG_DB.
2. Boot / `systemctl restart interfaces-config` on an image where IPv6 is disabled by the inherited per-interface default (`net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6=1`).
3. Observe `ifup eth0` cannot assign the IPv6 address.

**Describe the results you received**

- `ifup` reports `IPv6 is disabled on this device` and the mgmt IPv6 address is never assigned.
- eth0 has no IPv6 address (not even link-local) despite the `inet6 static` stanza in `/etc/network/interfaces`.
- Concrete downstream symptom: `snmpd` is configured (from CONFIG_DB) to listen on the mgmt IPv6 address, fails to bind it (`Cannot assign requested address` / `EADDRNOTAVAIL`), exits `1` on every start, hits the systemd start-limit, and the `snmp` container stays down — which trips `monit container_checker` (`Expected containers not running: snmp`) every minute and any LogAnalyzer-gated test.

```
snmpd: failed to bind ... 99 Cannot assign requested address
snmpd: Server Exiting with code 1
```

**Describe the results you expected**

The mgmt interface IPv6 address is programmed on eth0 whenever CONFIG_DB / `/etc/network/interfaces` list one, regardless of the inherited per-interface `disable_ipv6` default, and dependent services (e.g. `snmpd`) can bind it.

**Additional information you deem important**

Root cause is that `90-sonic.conf` only clears `net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6`, not `default`/`eth0`, so the mgmt port inherits `disable_ipv6=1` and `ifup` can't add the address. Fix: re-enable IPv6 on the mgmt port (`sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.<name>.disable_ipv6=0`) in the mgmt-interface `inet6` stanza before the address is assigned, mirroring the existing per-interface `disable_ipv6=0` pattern already used elsewhere in the tree (e.g. `usb-network-init.sh`). This is a general SONiC mgmt-IPv6 bug (not platform- or topology-specific).

PR: fixed by the accompanying `[interfaces] Enable IPv6 on the mgmt port before assigning its IPv6 address`.

resolution.title: [interfaces] Enable IPv6 on the mgmt port before assigning its IPv6 address
resolution.description:
Fixes #28317

#### Why I did it

When `MGMT_INTERFACE` has an IPv6 address, `ifup` writes the `eth0 inet6 static` stanza, but IPv6 can be **disabled on the mgmt port** — `net.ipv6.conf.eth0.disable_ipv6=1`, inherited from the runtime per-interface default. `90-sonic.conf` only clears `net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6`, not `default`/`eth0`. With IPv6 disabled on the port, `ifup` cannot assign the mgmt IPv6 address, so eth0 ends up with **no IPv6 at all** (not even a link-local) even though CONFIG_DB and `/etc/network/interfaces` list one.

Observed command output: `IPv6 is disabled on this device`; and, as a concrete downstream symptom, `snmpd` fails to bind the mgmt IPv6 address (`failed to bind ... 99 Cannot assign requested address` → `Server Exiting with code 1`), exits on every start, hits the systemd start-limit, so the `snmp` container stays down and `monit container_checker` logs `Expected containers not running: snmp` every minute → trips LogAnalyzer in gated tests.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

In the mgmt-interface stanza of `interfaces.j2`, when the prefix is IPv6, add a `pre-up sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.<name>.disable_ipv6=0` before the address is assigned. This mirrors the existing per-interface `disable_ipv6=0` pattern already used in the tree (e.g. `usb-network-init.sh`). IPv4-only mgmt stanzas are unaffected.

#### How to verify it

- **Template render:** the new `pre-up` line appears only on the IPv6 (`inet6`) mgmt stanza; IPv4-only mgmt config is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- **Live:** starting from a broken baseline (IPv6 disabled on eth0, `ifup` unable to assign the mgmt IPv6 address), `ifdown eth0 && ifup eth0` now re-enables IPv6 on the port and assigns the address; `snmpd` binds successfully, the `snmp` container stays Up, and the per-minute `monit container_checker` noise stops.
